title: Andean Passes Database (APD): census and climatic connectivity of Andean passes, code and derived data
description: Code, derived data, figures and supplementary tables for the article on the census and climatic connectivity of the passes of the tropical Andes (working title). Census of every pass of the divide network of the Andes (12°N-56°S) from FABDEM V1-2 at 1 arc-second, with height, depth, width, isolation, GMBA unit, the sea reached by each side and rank, validated against OpenStreetMap pass nodes, control passes and official heights. Climatic connectivity of every pass of the tropical Andes (11°N-23.5°S) in a transverse reading for lowland species and a longitudinal reading for montane species, by tiled wall-to-wall circuits on a 1 km grid with each of the 19 WorldClim 2.1 bioclimatic variables, in five configurations of margin and tile size. The code is under MIT; data, figures and tables follow LICENSE-DATA.md (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for files derived from FABDEM, non-commercial terms for files derived from WorldClim).
